title: Segmental ROM (peak-to-peak) of intact L1-S1 spines at ±7.5 Nm, female segments

quantity.name: ROM
quantity.definition: segmental range of motion, peak-to-peak (e.g. flexion+extension) over the 3rd cycle at ±7.5 Nm; mean ± SD of female FSUs

source.authors: Cook DJ, Yeager MS, Cheng BC
source.sample: 42 cadaveric L1-S1 spines; 204 FSUs (91 female, 113 male); L5-S1 tracked in 36 spines; human cadaveric lumbar spines L1-S1 (T12 and sacrum potted), intact condition pooled from 6 studies of one lab
source.sex: female segments only (91 F / 113 M FSUs overall)

protocol.summary: Pure moments ±7.5 Nm, sinusoidal, 0.005 Hz, 3 cycles per mode; 3rd cycle analysed; no preload reported; 6-DOF spine tester (Bose) with FE and LB gimbals; Optotrak LEDs on each vertebral body.
how_to_simulate: Model L1-S1 (T12 and sacrum potted); fix the sacrum, apply pure moment to the cranial end, no preload
Apply ±7.5 Nm in flexion-extension, lateral bending and axial rotation (3 cycles; use the 3rd)
Per level, report the full range (peak-to-peak) of the Euler angle of the upper vertebra relative to the lower one (sequence X y' z'): FE = alpha, LB = beta, AT = gamma
Compare with the sex-specific mean ± SD (female and male specimens are separate tests)
protocol.notes: ROM = range (peak-to-peak) over the 3rd cycle, i.e. flexion+extension, left+right LB, left+right AT. NZ not reported. Height/weight in source: mean 66.75 in (=169.5 cm) and 215.32 lb (=97.7 kg), converted here. Per-level, per-sex n not reported (all levels: 42 spines, L5-S1 36).

extraction.uncertainty: ±0.2 deg (mean and SD; pixel scale 21-39 px/deg)
extraction.check_notes: Bar tops and SD whisker caps located by pixel scan against tick-label centres; 6 points re-digitised with different column offsets: identical. LB F/M ratios match text (L3-4 +20%, L4-5 +53%). FE and AT ratios do NOT match text percentages (text FE 23-34%, AT 41-96%; digitised FE 29-41%, AT 20-67%); text likely uses adjusted means or is inconsistent - figure values kept.
